subject.title: fix(workboard): avoid duplicate proof entries on completion

question: Should `proofId` become the supported public Workboard correlation contract for resolving a separately recorded pending proof during completion?
rationale: The patch deliberately introduces an additive tool input and output that affects persisted proof-history semantics; this is an API-direction choice rather than a mechanical correctness repair.

options.title: Accept the explicit correlation contract
options.body: Keep the additive `proofId` input and result field, with the documented opt-in behavior and regression coverage.

options.title: Keep completion append-only
options.body: Reject the new public correlation surface and preserve the existing immutable proof-history behavior until a broader Workboard contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Accept the explicit correlation contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive `proofId` input and result field, with the documented opt-in behavior and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Available context connects this person to the paired report and proposed durable correlation boundary, though repository-history ownership could not be verified.
